directive: 画面上で操作と結果がすぐ分かる短い日本語にする。キー名、数値、変数を保つ。
translation_policy: F:\Games\Radiophobia 3\Translate\Radiophobia 3 会話グラフ翻訳方針.md

entries.EN: What the hell! Some motherfucker wasted the Arena Admin again! Somebody flay that scumbag and bring me his stinking carcass!
entries.JA_current: What the hell! Some motherfucker wasted the Arena Admin again! Somebody flay that scumbag and bring me his stinking carcass!
entries.JA_new: なんてこった！ また誰かがアリーナ管理人を殺りやがった！ そいつの皮を剥いで、腐った死体を持ってこい！

entries.EN: Hey, you bastard... When I find out your name... Trust me, you're better off jumping into the nearest anomaly, because when my men get you, I'll have them torture you for weeks on end until you beg me for death!
entries.JA_current: Hey, you bastard... When I find out your name... Trust me, you're better off jumping into the nearest anomaly, because when my men get you, I'll have them torture you for weeks on end until you beg me for death!
entries.JA_new: おい、このクソ野郎……名前が分かったら覚えておけ。近くのアノマリーに飛び込んだほうが身のためだ。うちの連中に捕まったら、死にたいと懇願するまで何週間も拷問してやる！

entries.EN: Attention all stalkers in the Bar! The Arena Admin has been killed again. Big reward and lifetime supply of ammo and food for whoever hunts him down, dead or alive, just finish this freak once and for all!
entries.JA_current: Attention all stalkers in the Bar! The Arena Admin has been killed again. Big reward and lifetime supply of ammo and food for whoever hunts him down, dead or alive, just finish this freak once and for all!
entries.JA_new: バーにいるストーカーたちに告ぐ！ またアリーナ管理人が殺された！ 犯人を生死を問わず捕まえた奴には、大金と弾薬・食料の一生分をくれてやる。このイカレ野郎を今度こそ始末しろ！

entries.EN: Guys, someone bumped off the Arena Administrator again. The assassin must still be somewhere nearby. Find him, but don't kill him: just bust all of his bones and roast him in the fireplace. Duty will collect the body later as decoration for trees at the entrance.
entries.JA_current: Guys, someone bumped off the Arena Administrator again. The assassin must still be somewhere nearby. Find him, but don't kill him: just bust all of his bones and roast him in the fireplace. Duty will collect the body later as decoration for trees at the entrance.
entries.JA_new: みんな、アリーナ管理人がまた殺られた。犯人はまだ近くにいるはずだ。見つけても殺すな。骨を全部へし折って、暖炉で焼け。あとでデューティーが死体を回収して、入口の木の飾りにする。

entries.EN: Well, guys, shit happened... Arnie got drunk and smacked into an anomaly... Got torn into pieces, not a single intact bone left. Therefore, there will be no more fights in the Arena, as you may have guessed. As soon as a new administrator is arranged, the news will be transmitted via the general channel.
entries.JA_current: Well, guys, shit happened... Arnie got drunk and smacked into an anomaly... Got torn into pieces, not a single intact bone left. Therefore, there will be no more fights in the Arena, as you may have guessed. As soon as a new administrator is arranged, the news will be transmitted via the general channel.
entries.JA_new: なあ、みんな……ひどいことになった。アーニーが酔っぱらってアノマリーに突っ込んじまった……バラバラだ。骨一本残ってない。察しのとおり、アリーナの試合はもうない。新しい管理人が決まったら、一般チャンネルで知らせる。

entries.EN: Damn it, the new Arena Admin got lost somewhere. If anybody comes across this drunkard, take him to the Bar immediately. If you ask me, there's a great likelihood the alky vanished in an anomaly or some other shit has happened... Whatever, the Arena will be closed until a new administrator has been found. Thanks to all! Dismissed.
entries.JA_current: Damn it, the new Arena Admin got lost somewhere. If anybody comes across this drunkard, take him to the Bar immediately. If you ask me, there's a great likelihood the alky vanished in an anomaly or some other shit has happened... Whatever, the Arena will be closed until a new administrator has been found. Thanks to all! Dismissed.
entries.JA_new: くそ、新しいアリーナ管理人がどこかへ消えちまった。見かけた奴は、すぐバーへ連れてきてくれ。俺に言わせりゃ、酔っ払いはアノマリーに消えたか、ほかに何かとんでもない目に遭ったんだろう……とにかく、新しい管理人が見つかるまでアリーナは閉鎖だ。以上、解散。

entries.EN: Dropped in at the Bar to toss off a glass. Do not turn over until Arena opening.
entries.JA_current: Dropped in at the Bar to toss off a glass. Do not turn over until Arena opening.
entries.JA_new: バーで一杯ひっかけてくる。アリーナが開くまで、ここで待つ。
entries.review_notes: ENの「Do not turn over」が文脈上不明瞭。アリーナ開場待ちの告知として「ここで待つ」と解釈。

entries.EN: Went to the Bar to squander your money on drinks. Losers!
entries.JA_current: Went to the Bar to squander your money on drinks. Losers!
entries.JA_new: バーに行って、酒に金を使ってくる。負け犬どもめ！

entries.EN: If anybody needs to talk to me - I gonna be at the Bar. But no talk will be smooth without first serving me a drink!
entries.JA_current: If anybody needs to talk to me - I gonna be at the Bar. But no talk will be smooth without first serving me a drink!
entries.JA_new: 俺に用があるならバーにいるぞ。ただし、一杯奢ってくれるまで話はなしだ！

entries.EN: What the... Everyday is same... Vodka here, vodka there and vodka again... In short: I'm at the Bar.
entries.JA_current: What the... Everyday is same... Vodka here, vodka there and vodka again... In short: I'm at the Bar.
entries.JA_new: なんだよ……毎日同じじゃねえか……ウォッカ、ウォッカ、またウォッカ……とにかく、俺はバーにいる。
